meaning:
§ Rephidim = "rests" or "stays" or "resting places"
a station of Israel in the wilderness between Egypt and Sinai

elsewhere.note: All the congregation of the children of Israel traveled from the wilderness of Sin, starting according to Yahweh’s commandment, and encamped in Rephidim; but…
They traveled from Alush, and encamped in Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.
